objective: Re-evaluate the incremental contribution of the probe-guided AST adapter under deterministic CUDA execution and three model seeds not used in formal-v2.1.

interpretation.result_awareness: The formal-v2.1 and same-seed rerun outcomes were known before this protocol was written.
interpretation.claim_boundary: Post-outcome exploratory robustness replication on the same 111 cats; not confirmatory evidence and not external validation.
interpretation.reporting_rule: Report every complete OOF result and the full paired distribution; no best-seed selection.

determinism.same_process_repeat_diagnostic: Two repeated repeat-0/fold-0/base-seed-17 adapter fits produced identical training trajectories and predictions after these settings were enabled.
